BiblicalUsage: Thirst itself, which Paul lists among his sufferings, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness, in hunger and thirst.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the apostle's thirst was part of his apostleship, and comfort is not the measure of faithfulness.
